reviews.reviewText:
Paper was damn easy. All MCQs from slides.
Subjective Questions:
1. Three strategies specifying basic steps of re-engineering.
2. Two key objectives of reverse engineering.
3. What is 'Technical debt'?
4. Two problems with refactoring.
5. Primary objectives of breaking down application into modules/services.
6. Five basic approaches to re-engineering software systems.
7. Benefits of Enterprise Architecture (at least four).
8. Two hats of Kent.
9. Define software re-architecting with example.
